name: Aruba
facts: Constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands

flag.description: A light blue field with two narrow parallel yellow stripes across the lower part and a white-edged red four-pointed star in the upper hoist corner.
flag.symbolism: Blue stands for the sea and sky and yellow for the sun and prosperity; the star is the island itself, its four points for the points of the compass, its red for the soil and its white edge for the beaches.

hook: Aruba is a sky-blue flag with a red four-pointed star in the corner and two thin yellow lines running along the bottom, like a sunlit horizon.
trivia: The flag was adopted on 18 March 1976, which Aruba celebrates every year as National Anthem and Flag Day.
Aruba left the Netherlands Antilles in 1986 to become a separate country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
